en: Dependent on a state with root-cause to be abandoned by vision that is accompanied by clinging (*saraṇa*), there arises a state not accompanied by clinging and not having a root-cause to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition.
Under root [condition] there is one; under object [condition] there is one ... pe ... under conascence [condition] there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.

Dependent on a state with root-cause to be abandoned by cultivation that is accompanied by clinging, there arises a state not accompanied by clinging and not having a root-cause to be abandoned by cultivation ... pe ... [and so forth].
A state arises by way of root condition. Under root: one; under object: one … pe … under conascence: three … pe … under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict (*araṇa*) and has a root to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a state that is without conflict and has a root to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of root condition. Under root: one … pe … under non-disappearance: one.
